theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_cc_jacobian_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (A : Euclid (n + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (ℓ : Euclid (n + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Euclid P) (D : Euclid (n + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) (ι : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)), Injective A → v ∈ LinearMap.range (A : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) → (∀ e, inner ℝ v (A e) = ℓ e) → Injective D → (∀ z, ℓ (D z) = z 0) → (∀ w, ι w 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, ι w i.succ = w i) → Injective (A ∘L D ∘L ι) ∧ LinearMap.range ((A ∘L D ∘L ι : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = LinearMap.range (A : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ ∧ Real.sqrt (((A ∘L D ∘L ι).adjoint ∘L (A ∘L D ∘L ι)).det) = ‖v‖ * Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det) * |D.det|
